title: The hard shoulder
summary: The team coach breaks down on the motorway two hours before kick-off. The gaffer wants a plan. A season on, the same coach, the same driver.

ends.title: The minibus
ends.text: When the coach broke down on the motorway, you got the squad to the game in a stranger's minibus.

ends.title: The hard shoulder
ends.text: The coach broke down and the squad sat on the hard shoulder until the police came.

beats.title: Junction twelve

event.title: Junction twelve
event.speaker: manager
setup: Junction twelve, two hours before kick-off. The team coach is on the hard shoulder with smoke coming out of the back. Twenty-two of you are on the grass behind the barrier in suits.

say: The gaffer is on the phone to the club and the club is not answering. "Ideas. Anybody. Now."

replies.label: "Taxis. Eight of them. Put it on the club."

taxis.text: Eight taxis, a fortune. You arrive in ones and twos, the last car at quarter to three. You win.

minibus.text: {mate.short}'s cousin turns up in a minibus with a hen party's banner still on the side. You get there at ten past two. It's the best warm-up the squad has ever had.

wait.text: You wait. The recovery comes at twenty to three. The game kicks off at four with the gaffer's permission and the other gaffer's sulk.

beats.hint: The team coach has broken down

beats.title: The same coach

event.title: The same coach
event.speaker: manager
setup: A season on. Same away trip, same coach, same driver. There's a sign above the driver's seat: DO NOT ASK ABOUT JUNCTION TWELVE.
{if arc.path=='minibus'}{mate.short} has his cousin's number on speed dial, just in case.{/if}

outcomes.text: The driver doesn't answer, and the whole coach sings the hen party song from the banner. The gaffer joins in at the second verse.
The driver goes very quiet. Somebody plays a siren noise on their phone.
You sleep. The coach gets there with an hour to spare.
You sleep. You wake at junction twelve because everybody is cheering.

beats.hint: A season on, the same coach
